seeds.name: Benih Unggul
seeds.description: Seleksi bibit padi dan palawija unggul tahan hama untuk melipatgandakan hasil panen sawah.
seeds.description_en: Selective breeding of resilient crop seeds to increase agricultural yield.

irrigation.name: Irigasi
irrigation.description: Pembangunan saluran irigasi subak teratur agar pasokan air lancar dan mempercepat masa tanam.
irrigation.description_en: Structured irrigation canal systems to improve water supply and accelerate crop growth.

fertilizer.name: Pupuk Organik
fertilizer.description: Pemanfaatan pupuk kompos dan kotoran ternak organik untuk menyuburkan tanah pertanian.
fertilizer.description_en: Use of organic compost and livestock manure to enrich farmland soil fertility and yields.

mechanization.name: Mekanisasi
mechanization.description: Penggunaan traktor tangan dan peralatan mekanis modern untuk mempercepat pembajakan lahan.
mechanization.description_en: Modern machinery and tractors accelerating soil tillage and farm operations.

processing.name: Pengolahan Industri
processing.description: Standardisasi mesin pabrik penggilingan dan fermentasi untuk mendongkrak efisiensi produksi.
processing.description_en: Standardized milling and processing machines boosting industrial manufacturing efficiency.

logistics.name: Logistik
logistics.description: Optimasi jalur pengiriman dan manajemen pergudangan desa guna menaikkan margin harga jual.
logistics.description_en: Optimized transport routes and storage logistics improving commodity trade margins.

renewables.name: Energi Terbarukan
renewables.description: Pemanfaatan pembangkit mikro hidro dan surya ramah lingkungan demi kenyamanan dan kebahagiaan warga.
renewables.description_en: Clean micro-hydro and solar rural electrification enhancing citizen happiness and comfort.
